approach_family: Parity padding of virtual Markov chain, exact virtual exchanges and primary priority
early_argument: Append one positive right classical stabilization to each odd-strand vertex. Conjugation and both virtual exchanges acquire a retained terminal crossing; stabilization across the two parity cases becomes a two-strand move or a terminal replacement. Need verify exact unrestricted virtual Markov formula/hypotheses and all relations. Soundness and completeness are universal imported-theorem deductions; ordinary closure, strand tags and syntactic block support are essential. Elementary consequence does not itself settle priority/status.
